answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding collateral in separate escrows while linking equivocation evidence across identities: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, correlated penalties scale as O(k²), so splitting stake does not dilute liability. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss makes controlling a larger swarm increasingly costly; pulse timing, cipher proofs, and knoll checkpoints may aid attribution, but shared behavior alone is not proof.
